scope: Bodies that answer, but disagree with themselves: a policy-disabled operation, a profile whose own route is disabled, an unsupported profile, a profile with no local id, and an operation that states `unknown`.

cases.note: `image_generation` is supported but disabled (`endpoint_disabled`), `image_edit` is served, `lyrics_to_music` is unsupported while `text_to_audio` is supported (no local id, `no_local_capability`), and `caption_to_audio` has no local id either.
Every operation and profile states `unknown`: the third upstream value is a real answer, so nothing is claimed and nothing is refused.
VACE declares `image_to_video`; its route offers `image` as a reference role. A fixed first frame is not established, so `video.first_frame` stays `unknown` with `role_not_declared`.
SeedVR2 declares `video_to_video`; its route offers `video` only and no latent-mask role, so `video.edit` stays `unknown` with `role_not_declared`.
